name: native-snapshot-source
goal: Run actual native acceptance from the selected Harness snapshot without borrowing live source or inventing revision identity

evidence: Actual acceptance needs Git inventories, but clean Harness exports contain no Git metadata. Supply selected immutable objects and give native builds their own export.
The standard snapshot matrix covers drift and output bounds but not selected Git source inventory. Extend it with a cold real Git object read inside the exported check.
